question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 G 组：新西兰 vs 比利时（90 分钟三路赛果）？
question_en: 2026 World Cup Group G: New Zealand vs Belgium (three-way result, 90 minutes)?
one_liner_cn: 比利时实力占优、约 68% 概率取胜，但末轮可能轮换且锋线带伤，新西兰拿分概率并非可以忽略。
one_liner_en: Belgium are clear favourites on strength at about 68%, but possible matchday-3 rotation and injured forwards mean New Zealand's chance of taking points is not negligible.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 差距 332 分（比利时 1894 vs 新西兰 1562），Davidson 统计模型给比利时约 70.6% 基线胜率。
key_reasons.en: A 332-point Elo gap (Belgium 1894 vs New Zealand 1562) gives Belgium a ~70.6% baseline win probability in the Davidson model.

key_reasons.cn: 比利时核心德布劳内与卢卡库均带伤入选，卢卡库本季仅踢约 1 小时正式比赛。
key_reasons.en: Belgium's De Bruyne and Lukaku were both selected while injured; Lukaku has played barely an hour of competitive football this season.

key_reasons.cn: 本场为 G 组末轮，比利时若提前出线可能轮换；新西兰头号射手伍德已确认完全伤愈。
key_reasons.en: This is Group G's final round and Belgium may rotate if already through; New Zealand's top striker Chris Wood is confirmed fully fit.

method_note: Market-blind: Davidson three-way Elo model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, neutral venue) baseline 10.4/19.0/70.6, plus bounded evidence adjustment (~2.6pp total, cap 8pp), renormalized. No betting or prediction-market data used.
